facts.fact: Camões reports that SIREC, launched at the 1.ª Conservatória de Bissau during the GESTDOC closing event of 22-23 January 2025, is an application with birth, marriage and death modules for registering acts in digital form, and that the first certificate was issued with it at the ceremony; it says the system will allow the move from paper to digital, not that offices had made it.
facts.system: Sistema Integrado de Registos e Estatísticas do Cidadão (SIREC)

facts.fact: Camões says SIREC was implemented at the Direção-Geral de Identificação Civil, Registo e Notariado, having been developed by the Universidade de Aveiro with training from Portugal's Instituto dos Registos e do Notariado, and launched in the presence of the Minister of Justice and Human Rights.
facts.system: Sistema Integrado de Registos e Estatísticas do Cidadão (SIREC)

facts.fact: Camões says SIREC was delivered under GESTDOC, a project financed by the European Union and managed and co-financed by Camões, I.P., which closed with the launch; no domestic funding is mentioned.
facts.system: Sistema Integrado de Registos e Estatísticas do Cidadão (SIREC)

systems.system: Sistema Integrado de Registos e Estatísticas do Cidadão (SIREC)

systems.owner: Direção-Geral de Identificação Civil, Registo e Notariado, Ministry of Justice and Human Rights
systems.tiers: launched and demonstrated at the 1.ª Conservatória de Bissau, 22-23 January 2025; no other office named

systems.owner: Direção-Geral de Identificação Civil, Registos e Notariado
systems.tiers: one vehicle handed over for mobile registration in remote areas; not said to be a permanent service

note: The launch is dated 22-23 January 2025, outside the twelve-month window, so no last12 fact; the source gives no count of offices using SIREC.
